## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      14 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 8, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sorce063_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "I’m uninstalling this app today. “4.7 is all about one thing: blocking that fires exactly when it should, 100% of the time” and yet blocking is still broken. Time limits don’t calculate correctly and resetting them doesn’t work 60% of the time. Every update says it fixes lag and overheat on the home page and yet, it still lags and overheats. Its drains my battery like nothing else, and struggles to do simple page switching. It’s frustrating, and I am done. Good luck, I truly hope you get better because your app was so important and I held on with hope it would get better, but it hasn’t and I need a new solution."
            2. _ChudLeeee_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "Opal was working perfectly fine for me before their newest update and I would even give it a 5 star before then. However, the new update makes the app so slow and bulky. It takes at least 1 minute for the app to load for me to actually block the apps I want to block. And, when I’m on my lunch break at work, it takes forever to even pause any of the blocked apps. The new interface is also not at all user friendly, whereas the one before was. Edit: updated the app again. Still doesn’t work."
            3. _Julios____, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Since the last update the app is no longer of any interest, we wait 5 seconds just to be able to unlock the app and it glitches so much that it's unusable. It's great to make beautiful apps, but make sure they work properly"
